lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀ ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee bhogee kaapaRee kiaa bhavahi disa(n)tar ||
lines.translation: Why do the Yogis, the revellers, and the beggars wander in foreign lands?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਹੀ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad na cheenhhee tat saar nira(n)tar ||3||
lines.translation: They do not understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the essence of excellence within them. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਜੋਇਸੀ ਨਿਤ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit paadhe joisee nit paRhahi puraanaa ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, the teachers and astrologers, and those who endlessly read the Puraanas,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar vasat na jaananhee ghat braham lukaanaa ||4||
lines.translation: do not know what is within; God is hidden deep within them. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਤਪਸੀ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik tapasee ban mahi tap karahi nit teerath vaasaa ||
lines.translation: Some penitents perform penance in the forests, and some dwell forever at sacred shrines.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾਮਸੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aap na cheenahi taamasee kaahe bhae udaasaa ||5||
lines.translation: The unenlightened people do not understand themselves - why have they become renunciates? ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਦੇ ਸੇ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik bi(n)d jatan kar raakhade se jatee kahaavahi ||
lines.translation: Some control their sexual energy, and are known as celibates.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bin gurasabad na chhootahee bhram aavahi jaavahi ||6||
lines.translation: But without the Guru's Word, they are not saved, and they wander in reincarnation. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik girahee sevak saadhikaa guramatee laage ||
lines.translation: Some are householders, servants, and seekers, attached to the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naam daan isanaan driR har bhagat s jaage ||7||
lines.translation: They hold fast to the Naam, to charity, to cleansing and purification; they remain awake in devotion to the Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur te dar ghar jaaneeai so jaai sinjaanai ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru, the Gate of the Lord's Home is found, and that place is recognized.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai saache man maanai ||8||14||
lines.translation: Nanak does not forget the Naam; his mind has surrendered to the True Lord. ||8||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਚਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa manahi samaaile bhaujal sach taranaa ||
lines.translation: Stilling the desires of the mind, the mortal truly crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad daiaal too thaakur teree saranaa ||1||
lines.translation: In the very beginning, and throughout the ages, You have been the Merciful Lord and Master; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤੌ ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too daatau ham jaachikaa har darasan deejai ||
lines.translation: You are the Giver, and I am a mere beggar. Lord, please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai man ma(n)dar bheejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; the temple of his mind resounds with joy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਤਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooRaa laalach chhodeeai tau saach pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: Renouncing false greed, one comes to realize the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad samaaeeai paramaarath jaanai ||2||
lines.translation: So let yourself be absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and know this supreme realization. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੁਭਤਉ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man raajaa lobheeaa lubhatau lobhaaee ||
lines.translation: This mind is a greedy king, engrossed in greed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh lobh nivaareeai har siu ban aaee ||3||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh eliminates his greed, and comes to an understanding with the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਰਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalar khetee beejeeai kiu laahaa paavai ||
lines.translation: Planting the seeds in the rocky soil, how can one reap a profit?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਗਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh sach na bheejaee kooR kooR gadaavai ||4||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is not pleased with Truth; the false are buried in falsehood. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਹੋ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: laalach chhodahu a(n)dhiho laalach dukh bhaaree ||
lines.translation: So renounce greed - you are blind! Greed only brings pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੌ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: saachau saahib man vasai haumai bikh maaree ||5||
lines.translation: When the True Lord dwells within the mind, the poisonous ego is conquered. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੁਵਾਟੜੀ ਮੂਸਹੁਗੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dubidhaa chhod kuvaataRee moosahuge bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Renounce the evil way of duality, or you shall be plundered, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis naam salaaheeai satigur saranaaee ||6||
lines.translation: Day and night, praise the Naam, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru's protection. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਥਰੁ ਸੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਫੀਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh pathar sail hai dhrig jeevan pheekaa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is a rock, a stone. His life is cursed and useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕੇਤਾ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਕਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jal mahi ketaa raakheeai abh a(n)tar sookaa ||7||
lines.translation: No matter now long a stone is kept under water, it still remains dry at its core. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan hai poorai gur deeaa ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is the treasure; the Perfect Guru has given it to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai math a(n)mrit peeaa ||8||15||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲੇ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chale chalanahaar vaat vataaiaa ||
lines.translation: The travellers travel from one road to another.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dh pite sa(n)saar sach na bhaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: The world is engrossed in its entanglements, and does not appreciate the Truth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਭਵੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa bhaveeai kiaa dhoodheeai gur sabad dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Why wander around, and why go searching, when the Guru's Shabad reveals Him to us?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਸਰਜਿਆ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mamataa mohu visarajiaa apanai ghar aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Leaving behind egotism and attachment, I have arrived at my own home. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach milai sachiaar kooR na paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Through Truth, one meets the True One; He is not obtained through falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sache siu chit laai bahuR na aaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: Centering your consciousness on the True Lord, you shall not have to come into the world again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਇਆ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਰੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: moiaa kau kiaa rovahu roi na jaanahoo ||
lines.translation: Why do you weep for the dead? You do not know how to weep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੂ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: rovahu sach salaahi hukam pachhaanahoo ||3||
lines.translation: Weep by praising the True Lord, and recognize His Command. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukamee vajahu likhaai aaiaa jaaneeai ||
lines.translation: Blessed is the birth of one who is destined to abide by the Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa palai paai hukam sinjaaneeai ||4||
lines.translation: He obtains the true profit, realizing the Lord's Command. ||4||
